episodes.title: The Lazy Burglar - Part One
episodes.summary: Maigret investigates Paris bank robberies. He turns his attention to the murder of a burglar, Honoré Cuendet, until the robbers strike again.

episodes.title: The Lazy Burglar - Part Two
episodes.summary: Maigret anticipates the robbers' next move and gets the chance to confront Cuendet's killers. But, the robbers have a larger master plan.

episodes.title: Maigret's Failure - Part One
episodes.summary: The team is interrupted when Maigret is ordered to investigate death threats received by a billionaire businessman, Ferdinand Fumal.

episodes.title: Maigret's Failure - Part Two
episodes.summary: As Maigret reels from regret, he suffers a blow in his personal life. Maigret digs into Fumal's life in order to understand him better.

episodes.title: Maigret Comes Home - Part One
episodes.summary: A student is stabbed to death in the street. Maigret digs into the killer's psychology. Countess Sophie calls, fearing for her life.

episodes.title: Maigret Comes Home - Part Two
episodes.summary: Tragedy strikes in Saint-Fiacre as Maigret digs into secrets. Back in Paris, Maigret's talks with the killer have terrifying consequences.
